playstyle.identity: Sivir is a waveclear ADC whose abilities bounce between enemies. Her spell shield blocks abilities, and her ultimate speeds her entire team.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives movement speed when hitting champions. Q is a boomerang that damages twice. W makes autos bounce to nearby enemies. E spell shields (blocks one ability, refunds mana). R speeds up nearby allies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sivir spikes with crit items for W bounces. Kraken or Galeforce work. She's a late-game teamfighter with AoE damage.

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.summary: Gain movement speed when hitting enemy champions.
passive.details: Sivir gains bonus movement speed for a short time when she damages an enemy champion with an ability or attack.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
abilities.summary: Throw a boomerang that damages enemies out and back.
abilities.details: Sivir throws her crossblade, dealing damage to enemies it passes through on the way out and back.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.summary: Auto attacks bounce to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Sivir's next few auto attacks bounce to additional enemies, dealing damage to each target.

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.summary: Block the next enemy ability; gain mana if successful.
abilities.details: Sivir creates a shield that blocks the next enemy ability. If successful, she heals and restores mana.

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.summary: Rally nearby allies, giving everyone bonus movement speed.
abilities.details: Sivir rallies her allies, granting herself and nearby allies bonus movement speed for a duration.
